title: The nurse's shift
subtitle: Same database, a different product: a list of what is due, and a score you see before you save

steps.caption: A nurse lands on My Shift, not on a chart: medications and observations due now, each with how late it is.
My patients: the ward as this nurse owns it.
Record observations: big numeric targets built for a tablet on a trolley.
NEWS2 computes live as the values go in, with the RCP escalation sentence underneath. She sees what she is about to trigger before she saves it.
Handover: an I-PASS draft written from recorded data, to be read against the patient before handing over.
